components/ConditionalChrome.tsx.name: Footer and chat visibility
components/ConditionalChrome.tsx.description: Hides the footer and concierge chat on internal tool pages so they look like standalone screens.

components/ConditionalLayout.tsx.name: Page layout switcher
components/ConditionalLayout.tsx.description: Picks the right page layout — floating header on the homepage, fixed header on shop pages, or no header at all on internal tools.

components/HeroImage.tsx.name: Homepage hero banner
components/HeroImage.tsx.description: Shows the main landing image with the Elysium logo, tagline, and links to shop or book an appointment.

components/icons/DiamondIcons.tsx.name: Diamond shape icons
components/icons/DiamondIcons.tsx.description: Provides a matching icon for every diamond shape (round, oval, princess, pear, emerald, and more) used across the shop.

components/icons/LuxuryIcons.tsx.name: Trust and service icons
components/icons/LuxuryIcons.tsx.description: Supplies premium icons for hallmark certification, returns, and complimentary services shown alongside product details.

components/mobile/MobileGallery.tsx.name: Mobile image swiper
components/mobile/MobileGallery.tsx.description: Lets phone and tablet visitors swipe through product photos with touch gestures and dot indicators.

components/mobile/TouchOptimized.tsx.name: Touch-friendly controls
components/mobile/TouchOptimized.tsx.description: Gives buttons, cards, and pull-to-refresh controls a responsive feel with ripple effects on phones and tablets.

components/navigation/MobileMenu.tsx.name: Mobile navigation menu
components/navigation/MobileMenu.tsx.description: Opens a full-screen menu on phones so visitors can browse collections, education pages, and account links.

components/OptionsSelector.tsx.name: Product option picker
components/OptionsSelector.tsx.description: Lets the customer choose a metal, stone, and ring size from the available options on a product page.

components/PlausibleAnalytics.tsx.name: Visitor analytics
components/PlausibleAnalytics.tsx.description: Loads the Plausible script so the shop can see how many people visit each page without using cookies.

components/Price.tsx.name: Price display
components/Price.tsx.description: Shows a product price formatted in British pounds wherever a price needs to appear.

components/ProductGallery.tsx.name: Product photo gallery
components/ProductGallery.tsx.description: Displays the full set of product images in a scrollable gallery on the product page.

components/providers/LenisProvider.tsx.name: Smooth scrolling
components/providers/LenisProvider.tsx.description: Makes page scrolling feel luxuriously smooth and keeps scroll-triggered animations in sync across the site.

components/RingSizeGuide.tsx.name: Ring size guide
components/RingSizeGuide.tsx.description: Shows customers how to measure their finger and find the right ring size.

components/ServiceWorkerRegistration.tsx.name: Offline readiness
components/ServiceWorkerRegistration.tsx.description: Registers a background worker so returning visitors load the shop faster and see a friendly message when offline.

components/ShopGrid.tsx.name: Product grid
components/ShopGrid.tsx.description: Displays products in a filterable grid, grouped by collection or sorted by the customer's chosen filters.

components/ui/AccessibilityProvider.tsx.name: Accessibility settings
components/ui/AccessibilityProvider.tsx.description: Detects visitor preferences for reduced motion and screen readers and adjusts the site to respect them.

components/ui/Breadcrumb.tsx.name: Breadcrumb trail
components/ui/Breadcrumb.tsx.description: Shows a clickable trail of links at the top of each page so visitors can navigate back to parent sections.

components/ui/CollectionsMegaMenu.tsx.name: Collections menu
components/ui/CollectionsMegaMenu.tsx.description: Opens a wide dropdown in the header listing every jewellery collection so visitors can jump straight to one.

components/ui/DiamondShapesDropdown.tsx.name: Diamond shapes menu
components/ui/DiamondShapesDropdown.tsx.description: Opens a dropdown of diamond shape options with icons so visitors can filter products by shape.

components/ui/EducationMegaMenu.tsx.name: Education menu
components/ui/EducationMegaMenu.tsx.description: Opens a wide dropdown in the header linking to diamond guides and educational content.

components/ui/Header.tsx.name: Site header
components/ui/Header.tsx.description: Shows the top navigation bar with links to the shop, cart, and wishlist on every page.

components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx.name: Loading indicators
components/ui/LoadingSpinner.tsx.description: Shows spinning or overlay animations while content is loading so visitors know the page is working.

components/ui/LuxuryButton.enhanced.tsx.name: Animated luxury button
components/ui/LuxuryButton.enhanced.tsx.description: Renders a premium-styled button with hover and click animations used for calls to action.

components/ui/LuxuryButton.tsx.name: Luxury button
components/ui/LuxuryButton.tsx.description: Renders a clean, brand-styled button used for actions across the shop.

components/ui/LuxuryHeader.tsx.name: Main navigation header
components/ui/LuxuryHeader.tsx.description: Displays the Elysium logo, collection menus, search bar, wishlist, and cart icons at the top of every page.

components/ui/LuxuryProductCard.tsx.name: Product card
components/ui/LuxuryProductCard.tsx.description: Shows a product thumbnail with its name, price, and a quick-add-to-wishlist button inside any grid or carousel.

components/ui/MetalSwatch.tsx.name: Metal colour swatch
components/ui/MetalSwatch.tsx.description: Displays small clickable colour circles for yellow gold, white gold, rose gold, and platinum on product pages.

components/ui/OptimizedImage.tsx.name: Fast-loading images
components/ui/OptimizedImage.tsx.description: Loads product and lifestyle images progressively so they appear quickly without slowing the page down.

components/ui/ProductCard.tsx.name: Standard product card
components/ui/ProductCard.tsx.description: Shows a compact product preview with image, name, price, and a wishlist toggle for listing pages.

components/ui/RingSizeGuide.tsx.name: Ring size reference
components/ui/RingSizeGuide.tsx.description: Displays a pop-up ring-sizing chart that customers can open from any product page.

components/ui/SearchBar.tsx.name: Product search
components/ui/SearchBar.tsx.description: Lets visitors type a keyword to instantly find matching rings, diamonds, or collections.

components/ui/SkipLinks.tsx.name: Skip-to-content links
components/ui/SkipLinks.tsx.description: Gives keyboard and screen-reader users invisible links to jump straight to main content, navigation, or search.

components/ux/FadeInOnScroll.tsx.name: Scroll fade-in effect
components/ux/FadeInOnScroll.tsx.description: Gently fades content into view as the visitor scrolls down the page.

components/ux/StaggerOnScroll.tsx.name: Staggered reveal effect
components/ux/StaggerOnScroll.tsx.description: Reveals a group of items one after another as the visitor scrolls, creating an elegant cascade.

styles/luxury-animations.css.name: Brand animations
styles/luxury-animations.css.description: Defines the signature hover glows, fade-ins, and shimmer effects that give the shop its luxury feel.

styles/luxury-typography.css.name: Brand typography
styles/luxury-typography.css.description: Sets the serif and sans-serif font styles, sizes, and spacing used across every page.

styles/tokens.css.name: Design tokens
styles/tokens.css.description: Stores the brand colours, spacing values, and shadow styles shared by every part of the shop.
